weaknesses.title: READALL default joins files with empty sep — fields glue without NL
weaknesses.detail: READALL bag produces host=keep port=3host=old port=2… unless sep given. Agents expecting newline join must pass "\n" or "|||". Easy silent parse errors on digest.
weaknesses.repro: READALL three cfgs → glued string no boundaries

weaknesses.title: REPLACEALL is string in-memory; REPLACEFILES is path bag rewrite
weaknesses.detail: Same trap class as GREP/GREPFILES and APPENDALL/LOGALL. Wrong op rewrites bag field text, never touches disk.
weaknesses.repro: REPLACEALL path_bag old new leaves file content unchanged

weaknesses.title: REPLACEFILES empty old is silent no-op (SKIP all)
weaknesses.detail: Documented in proof; empty needle from ARG miss can look like success-zero-change if agent does not REQUIRE.

weaknesses.title: WRITEALL creates missing paths and overwrites without backup
weaknesses.detail: No dry-run or existing-only mode. Fleet reset is destructive one-shot.

weaknesses.title: No REPLACEFILESI case-insensitive bulk rewrite
weaknesses.detail: Host=Old vs host=old needs dual scrub or GREPFILESI+custom. String REPLACEALL has no I-path dual either for files.

weaknesses.title: WRITE/WRITEALL omit trailing NL on content unless in data
weaknesses.detail: plate-v1 files have no final $ on cat -A; DIGEST plate same.

weaknesses.title: READALL partial miss sets OK=0 while still returning concat
weaknesses.detail: Strict -s agents need CLEAR_ERR after partial success. Same class as RMALL/COPYALL partial OK.

workarounds: Always pass explicit sep to READALL (newline or |||)
Use REPLACEFILES not REPLACEALL for disk rewrites
REQUIRE scrub_n>0 or treat SKIP-only as miss at agent layer
CLEAR_ERR after partial READALL if digest usable
Include trailing NL in WRITEALL data if needed
issues_faced: Default READALL glue surprised — need explicit sep
Empty ARG1 blocked by agent EXIT before language empty-old no-op
